WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM olist_orders o

    AND EXISTS (

),
item_totals AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS amount
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN qualifying_orders q ON q.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS amount,
       COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM item_totals;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date >= '2018-07-01'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date < '2018-08-01'
),
item_totals AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.price) AS item_total
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN delivered_orders d ON d.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
payment_totals AS (
  SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS payment_total
  FROM olist_order_payments p
  JOIN delivered_orders d ON d.order_id = p.order_id
  GROUP BY p.order_id
  HAVING SUM(p.payment_value) > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value / pt.payment_total * it.item_total), 2) AS allocated_total
FROM olist_order_payments p
JOIN payment_totals pt ON pt.order_id = p.order_id
JOIN item_totals it ON it.order_id = p.order_id;

FROM payment_by_order;

WITH paid_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM olist_order_payments) SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_freight, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders_with_items FROM olist_orders o JOIN paid_orders p ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN olist_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM olist_orders o
JOIN olist_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN olist_order_payments op ON op.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01';

SELECT p.payment_type, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS payment_amount
FROM olist_order_payments p
JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01'
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY p.payment_type ASC;

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM olist_orders o
JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN olist_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01'
  AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY c.customer_state ASC;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01'

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM olist_orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-31'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM olist_order_payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
FROM eligible e
LEFT JOIN olist_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = e.order_id;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS product_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2015-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2015-02-01'

WITH filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM olist_orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM olist_order_payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id
    )
),
item_by_order AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS amount
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN filtered_orders fo ON fo.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM item_by_order;

WITH item_by_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS item_total
  FROM olist_order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
), payment_by_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_total
  FROM olist_order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
), alloc AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    SUM(p.payment_value * i.item_total / pay.payment_total) AS allocated_amount
  FROM olist_orders o
  JOIN item_by_order i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN payment_by_order pay ON pay.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01'
    AND pay.payment_total > 0
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(allocated_amount), 2) AS allocated_total
FROM alloc;
